# notification-kit — Documentation Index

> notification-kit is a unified notification library for React + Capacitor apps. One API for push notifications (via Firebase Cloud Messaging or OneSignal), local notifications (via @capacitor/local-notifications), and in-app toast notifications, across Web, iOS, and Android. Zero required dependencies — every peer dependency is optional and loaded dynamically. Dual ESM + CJS build, full TypeScript types, optional React hooks. MIT-licensed. npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/notification-kit. Author: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## About

`notification-kit` gives a React + Capacitor app a single notification API instead of wiring Firebase / OneSignal / Capacitor plugins separately. You initialize once with a provider, then call `notifications.requestPermission()`, `getToken()`, `subscribe()`, `schedule()`, `showInApp()`, `createChannel()`, and listen with `onPush()` / `on(event)`. The same calls work on Web, iOS, and Android; the library detects the platform and degrades gracefully when an optional dependency is not installed.

Honest scope: push **sending** and FCM **topic (un)subscription** are server-side operations (Firebase Admin SDK / IID API) — the client SDK throws a descriptive error pointing you to your backend, because performing them client-side would require shipping admin credentials. This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/intro): What notification-kit is, the three notification types, and how the unified API is structured.
- [Installation](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/installation): npm/yarn install + which optional peer dependencies to add per provider and platform.
- [Quick Start](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/quick-start): Initialize, request permission, get a token, and show your first in-app notification in five minutes.
- [Configuration](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/configuration): The full `NotificationConfig` object — provider, in-app defaults, debug, storage, and feature flags.

## Guides

- [Push notifications](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/push-notifications): Permission, token, topics, and receiving messages with `onPush`.
- [Local notifications](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/local-notifications): Schedule at a date, after a delay, or on a recurring pattern; cancel, list pending, read delivered.
- [In-app notifications](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/in-app-notifications): Toast success/error/warning/info with positions, durations, and actions.
- [Android channels](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/channels): Create/list/delete channels with importance, visibility, sound, vibration, lights.
- [Permissions](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/permissions): Provider-driven vs the standalone permission helper; permission states.
- [Events](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/events): The full event map and how to subscribe/unsubscribe.
- [React hooks](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/guides/react-hooks): `useNotifications` and the in-app notification hooks.

## Platform Setup

- [Web](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/platforms/web): Service worker template, VAPID key, browser support matrix.
- [Android](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/platforms/android): `google-services.json`, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, channels, FCM setup.
- [iOS](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/platforms/ios): APNs key, Push Notifications capability, background modes.

## Providers

- [Firebase (FCM)](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/providers/firebase): `FirebaseConfig` (raw config or existing app), VAPID key, server-side topic/send caveats.
- [OneSignal](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/providers/onesignal): `OneSignalConfig` (appId or existing instance), prompt and notify-button options.

## API Reference

- [API overview](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/api-overview): Every export from `notification-kit` and `notification-kit/react`.
- [NotificationKit class](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/notification-kit): `init`, `requestPermission`, `getToken`, `subscribe`, `scheduleLocalNotification`, `createChannel`, `on/off`, `destroy`.
- [notifications helper](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/notifications): The flat convenience API (`schedule`, `cancel`, `getPending`, `getDelivered`, `success/error/warning/info`, `onPush`).
- [React hooks](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/react-hooks): `useNotifications`, `useInAppNotification` and its variants, with full return types.
- [Config & types](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/config-types): `NotificationConfig`, `FirebaseConfig`, `OneSignalConfig`, `ScheduleOptions`, `InAppOptions`, `NotificationChannel`.
- [Events](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/events): The complete event-name → payload map.
- [Utilities](https://notification-kit-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/utilities): `validate`, `format`, `SchedulingUtils`, `platform`, `permissions`, `storage`, `quickStart`, `dev`.
